I am ready to welcome you into the fold, but the Blue Chamber is built on more than just good will. We require a binding commitment to clear a Blood Price. Return to me when you hold a Blue Chamber Pact.

Simeon has a habit of seeing the best in people, but I prefer tangible proof. If you truly wish to join the Heroic Kingdom, you must first secure a Heroic Kingdom Pact. Without it, your words are as empty as the desert wind.

I sense the spark within you, but a flame requires fuel to burn. The path of the Holy Mission is one of sacrifice, not convenience. Return to the altar only when you carry a Holy Mission Pact to seal your vow.

You speak of ambition, but the Academy runs on results, not words. Consider this your first assignment: acquire a Sorobor Academy Pact. If you cannot secure even that simple asset, you have no future in Harmattan.
